#summary This are guidelines on how to design a model that is to be used with EMFStore

= Obligatory Rules: Do´s and Dont´s =

    * Do NOT use the URI "/plugin/org.eclipse.emf.ecore/model/Ecore.ecore#//". Use the "http://..." URIs
    * Do NOT use generics in the Ecore!
    * Do NOT just override a getter or setter! If you want to override a setter or getter follow the recommended best practice in emf:
          o Rename generated setter or getter to get/setXGen
          o Write your own getter/setter marked with @generated NOT and call the get/setXGen
          o Your added code must be null safe for any input parameter!
          o Emf will now always update the generated part but leave your code untouched 
 All model elements must have "ModelElement" set as superclass
         2. All reference features of model elements must have the key property set to "identifier"
         3. All model elements must either be contained by another model element or by project
         4. The reference feature "lower bound" must NOT be greater than zero for any model element feature reference
         5. The id property must NOT be set for any model element feature
         6. Do NOT use simple attributes with a multiplicity greater than 1.
         7. Do NOT set unsetable to true for any feature
         8. Do NOT create non-transient reference to anything other than model element subtypes
